top_signals.title: Oil extends gains, Brent crude nears $108 following Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
top_signals.summary: Oil extended gains amid reports of fresh Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and attacks by Iran on ships in the Gulf.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BofA Sees Chance of $150 Oil on Critical Infrastructure Risk
top_signals.summary: Francisco Blanch, commodities and derivatives research head at BofA Securities, says Brent oil prices could climb as high as $150 a barrel if critical infrastructure, like Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, "is hit on a more permanent basis." Blanch speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
top_signals.summary: A new identity theft service launched on the dark web this week is selling digital scans of more than 153 million drivers licenses from people in the United States and Canada. Based on interviews with individuals whose licenses are available for purchase on this service, it appears to be siphoning images collected by a widely-used identity verification company based in Louisiana. KrebsOnSecurity also has learned that the New Orleans field office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) today launched an official inquiry into the source of the images.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Cabinet approves outline of two-year consumption tax reduction for food products
top_signals.summary: The plan will form the basis of related bills set to be submitted to the autumn session of parliament to reduce the consumption tax from 8% to 1%.
